summary: The IO list contains numerous fundamental errors in I/O type classification. Passive primary elements (e.g., FE, TE, TW, RO) are incorrectly listed as I/O points. Many physical transmitters (e.g., FIT, PIT, TIT, ZT) and switches (e.g., HS, HSD, PSDH, PSDL) are wrongly classified as 'Soft Link' instead of their appropriate Analog Input (AI) or Digital Input (DI) types. This indicates a significant gap in understanding I/O definition and instrument classification, requiring substantial manual review and correction.

comments.issue: Flow Element (FE) is a passive primary element and does not have an I/O point. It should not be listed in an I/O schedule.
comments.reason: Including passive elements as I/O inflates I/O counts and misrepresents the control system scope.

comments.issue: Radiation Orifice (RO) is a passive primary element and does not have an I/O point. It should not be listed in an I/O schedule.
comments.reason: Including passive elements as I/O inflates I/O counts and misrepresents the control system scope.

comments.issue: Temperature Element (TE) is a passive primary element (e.g., RTD, Thermocouple) and does not have an I/O point itself. It connects to a transmitter or direct input card.
comments.reason: Including passive elements as I/O inflates I/O counts and misrepresents the control system scope.

comments.issue: Thermowell (TW) is a passive mechanical component and does not have an I/O point. It should not be listed in an I/O schedule.
comments.reason: Including passive elements as I/O inflates I/O counts and misrepresents the control system scope.

comments.issue: Flow Indicator Transmitter (FIT) is a physical instrument that measures flow and transmits a signal. It should be an Analog Input (AI).
comments.reason: Incorrect I/O type leads to inaccurate I/O counts and incorrect wiring/system design.

comments.issue: Pressure Indicator Transmitter (PIT) is a physical instrument that measures pressure and transmits a signal. It should be an Analog Input (AI).
comments.reason: Incorrect I/O type leads to inaccurate I/O counts and incorrect wiring/system design.

comments.issue: Temperature Indicator Transmitter (TIT) is a physical instrument that measures temperature and transmits a signal. It should be an Analog Input (AI).
comments.reason: Incorrect I/O type leads to inaccurate I/O counts and incorrect wiring/system design.

comments.issue: Position Transmitter (ZT) is a physical instrument that measures position and transmits a signal. It should be an Analog Input (AI).
comments.reason: Incorrect I/O type leads to inaccurate I/O counts and incorrect wiring/system design.

comments.issue: Operator Hand Switch (HS) is a physical device that provides a discrete signal. It should be a Digital Input (DI).
comments.reason: Incorrect I/O type leads to inaccurate I/O counts and incorrect wiring/system design.

comments.issue: Emergency Shutdown Hand Switch (HSD) is a physical device that provides a discrete signal. It should be a Digital Input (DI).
comments.reason: Incorrect I/O type leads to inaccurate I/O counts and incorrect wiring/system design, especially critical for safety systems.

comments.issue: Pressure Safety Differential High (PSDH) is a pressure switch providing a discrete signal. It should be a Digital Input (DI).
comments.reason: Incorrect I/O type leads to inaccurate I/O counts and incorrect wiring/system design, especially critical for safety systems.

comments.issue: Pressure Safety Differential Low (PSDL) is a pressure switch providing a discrete signal. It should be a Digital Input (DI).
comments.reason: Incorrect I/O type leads to inaccurate I/O counts and incorrect wiring/system design, especially critical for safety systems.

comments.issue: Generic 'P' tag for Pressure. If this represents a pressure transmitter, it should be AI. If it's a pressure switch, it should be DI. 'Soft Link' is unlikely for a physical pressure instrument.
comments.reason: Misclassification of physical instruments as 'Soft Link' leads to missing I/O points and incorrect scope.

comments.issue: Position Indicator High (ZIH). If this is a limit switch, it should be a Digital Input (DI). If it's a local indicator, it's passive.
comments.reason: Misclassification of physical instruments as 'Soft Link' leads to missing I/O points and incorrect scope.

comments.issue: Position Indicator Low (ZIL). If this is a limit switch, it should be a Digital Input (DI). If it's a local indicator, it's passive.
comments.reason: Misclassification of physical instruments as 'Soft Link' leads to missing I/O points and incorrect scope.

comments.issue: Process Conductivity Control (CC). If this refers to a physical conductivity analyzer or transmitter, it should be an Analog Input (AI).
comments.reason: Vague 'Soft Link' for a potentially physical instrument leads to incomplete I/O data.

comments.issue: Conductivity (CP). If this refers to a physical conductivity sensor or transmitter, it should be an Analog Input (AI).
comments.reason: Vague 'Soft Link' for a potentially physical instrument leads to incomplete I/O data.

comments.issue: Local Flow Indication (FQI). If this device provides retransmission or pulse output, it should be an Analog Input (AI) or Digital Input (DI).
comments.reason: Vague 'Soft Link' for a potentially physical instrument leads to incomplete I/O data.

comments.issue: Generic 'FROM' tag for Flow. If this represents a flow transmitter, it should be an Analog Input (AI).
comments.reason: Vague 'Soft Link' for a potentially physical instrument leads to incomplete I/O data.

comments.issue: Current (IN). If this represents a current transmitter, it should be an Analog Input (AI).
comments.reason: Vague 'Soft Link' for a potentially physical instrument leads to incomplete I/O data.

comments.issue: Level (LP). If this represents a level transmitter, it should be AI. If it's a level switch, it should be DI.
comments.reason: Vague 'Soft Link' for a potentially physical instrument leads to incomplete I/O data.

comments.issue: Pressure Signal Conversion (PY). If this is a transducer (e.g., P/I converter), it will have I/O (AI and/or AO).
comments.reason: Vague 'Soft Link' for a potentially physical instrument leads to incomplete I/O data.

comments.issue: Speed (SH). If this represents a speed transmitter, it should be AI. If it's a speed switch, it should be DI.
comments.reason: Vague 'Soft Link' for a potentially physical instrument leads to incomplete I/O data.

comments.issue: Speed Signal Conversion (SY). If this is a transducer, it will have I/O (AI and/or AO).
comments.reason: Vague 'Soft Link' for a potentially physical instrument leads to incomplete I/O data.

comments.issue: Process Alarm (XA). If this refers to an alarm switch (e.g., XAH, XAL), it should be a Digital Input (DI).
comments.reason: Vague 'Soft Link' for a potentially physical instrument leads to incomplete I/O data.
